title.zh: Aviva Investors launches tokenized share class of $29B Sterling fund on XRP Ledger
title.en: Aviva Investors launches tokenized share class of $29B Sterling fund on XRP Ledger

current_state.zh: Aviva Investors launched a tokenized share class of its £22 billion ($29.4B) Sterling Liquidity Fund on the XRP Ledger, its second tokenized fund following a USD Liquidity Fund launch in July, bringing its combined tokenized money-market offerings to roughly £86 million.
